rt_rows.argument: Counter-scenario: a loud confrontational stunt could seize the Li-9 visibility without partnership work. Alternative reading: 丁奇入墓 could mean 'abandon the data-report asset'. Rejected as over-reading — the same palace carries 青龙耀明 + 宫生门 + 犬遇青龙 (substance is auspicious); the tomb markers gate distribution, not worth. Bounded publication (slow 九地 channels, pre-unblocked routes) is the reconciling reading.
Attaching to established patrons (星随月转) is the cooperative P9 engine expressed at the outreach layer: pitch documents to editors/experts who already hold the audience.

Root constraint: centre duplication lodges into the document palace, therefore keyword lists, page targets and message hierarchy must be deduplicated before amplification.

If deception is exposed at the discovery door, then every published number must be traceable to a free real source (Google Trends, autocomplete, related searches) — which is exactly CONK-007's permitted toolset.
